newsitem.title: USA: Republic shr offering is private placement.
newsitem.headline: Republic shr offering is private placement.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said it intends to close Friday on a private placement transaction for the sale of 12,085,000 shares, for an aggregate purchase price of $356,507,500.
The proceeds from this sale will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Republic Industries Vice President David Potts said the shares will be purchased by institutional investors.
Thursday the company said it signed a definitive agreement to merge with Alamo-Rent-A-Car Inc in a transaction valued at $625 million.
